data_description.poll_interval: How often the hub is asked for the state of every shade. Each request makes the hub serialise its whole state document; 2 is the upstream default, 10 or more is kinder to the hub.
data_description.signal_poll_interval: How often ONE shade is asked, over the hub's serial port, for a live radio signal reading (shades take turns). The hub's own cached value does not refresh on its own on Pulse Pro hubs.
